content: CSV encoding/dialect detection edge cases: BOM presence changes outcome entirely (UTF-8 BOM vs Windows-1252 default from Excel-on-Windows exports) -- must sniff BOM first before falling back to chardet/charset-normalizer, which are heuristic, return confidence scores, and are not 100% reliable (especially on short files or files with mixed-language content). CleverCSV improves on stdlib csv.Sniffer by scoring dialect candidates against a 'data consistency' heuristic (does the resulting parsed table look like real tabular data) rather than pure regex/heuristic sniffing, which materially reduces false-positive delimiter detection on files with quoted fields containing commas or embedded newlines.
